card.name: Word right after a time or condition lead-in
card.fires_on: The word or space right after a lead-in like "in case", "before" or "as soon as", where a number, age or time is expected next. Seen mostly after "as soon as" before "48 hours".

modes.label: After "as soon as"
modes.description: The space slot after "as soon as", just before a number of hours.
modes.example: oligohydramnios has been infrequently reported as soon as<< >>48 hours after NSAID initiation.

modes.label: After "before" with an age
modes.description: The word "age" after "before", ahead of an age number.
modes.example: Ulcerative colitis usually appears before<< age>> 30.

modes.label: After "in case"
modes.description: The word "if" following "in case" in a conditional.
modes.example: "In case<< if>> an earthquake really happened," Sandy says.
